svg.title: Per-application Vault Agent proxies sharing one software TPM
svg.desc: The Payments and Analytics applications each run under a dedicated Unix user and reach their own mode-0600 Vault Agent socket. During normal login, each agent uses its distinct TPM key to sign the TLS handshake and logs in through Vault auth/tpm with a fixed role. The shared enrolled TPM identity anchors certificate acquisition and renewal. Cross-application socket access and cross-secret access are rejected.
svg.text: One TPM, two identities: a Vault Agent proxy per application
Each application reaches Vault only through its own owner-only socket and its own TPM-held key, and can read only its own secret.
Role is fixed in the agent config.
private keys never leave the TPM
A caller-supplied token cannot widen what the proxy sends to Vault.
